entries.4ec8e6774b9906fb: This business develops, manufactures and sells single crystals and laser light sources for manufacturers of semiconductor wafer inspection equipment. It is characterized by shorter wavelengths through wavelength conversion (266nm) and higher output, and maintenance demand, such as replacement of delivered single crystals and optical units, accounts for about 20% of this business's revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥5,002 million.

entries.848899ec27b3abd9: This business develops, manufactures and sells single crystals, optical components, laser light sources and optical measuring equipment for optical measurement equipment and optical product manufacturers in Japan and overseas, and for research institutions such as universities. It is also responsible for developing new applications and products using single-crystal and optical technologies, and Faraday rotators for data centers have been commercialized. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥3,040 million.

entries.a13c72328b122f1b: This is a single-segment business that develops, manufactures and sells optics-related products such as single crystals, optical components (optical devices), laser light sources and optical measurement equipment. It is based at its head office and factory complex in Hokuto, Yamanashi Prefecture, and its Yokohama office in Yokohama, Kanagawa Prefecture, and conducts business together with its consolidated subsidiary OXIDE Power Crystal Corporation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥10,040 million.

entries.a7e59e99fc17eda5: This business develops, manufactures and sells scintillator single crystals installed in PET inspection equipment used for cancer diagnosis. It sells PET elements made by processing single crystals to PET inspection equipment manufacturers in Japan and overseas. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,997 million.
